pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions within 15 minutes of a prior execution or during elevated high-impact ATR expansion candles to prevent compounding into falling/rising wicks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require institutional order-flow imbalance confirmation combined with a minimum 3-ATR buffer away from immediate structural liquidity pools prior to order entry.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing profit locks at +$10.00 floating profit to ensure winners consistently scale into the +$15.00 to +$30.00 target bracket.
